item.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to overturn $83.3 million E. Jean Carroll case
item.description: President Trump is asking the Supreme Court to throw out an $83.3 million defamation judgment won by writer E. Jean Carroll.

item.title: Trump to announce $22.5 billion plan to overhaul Dulles International Airport
item.description: President Donald Trump and Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy are expected to announce plans Wednesday for a $22.5 billion overhaul of Dulles International Airport.

item.title: Why are airlines banning humanoid robots from flights?
item.description: Three major U.S. airlines have quietly changed their policies to ban humanoid and animal-like robots from flights.

item.title: Trump asks SCOTUS to overturn $83M Carroll judgment based on presidential immunity
item.description: President Trump has asked the Supreme Court to overturn the $83 million judgment a jury awarded E. Jean Carroll after another jury held Trump liable for defamation.
